summary.text: Brandon Guffey is a Republican state representative from South Carolina House District 48 who has served since November 2022 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He owns an HVAC business in Rock Hill.

paragraphs.text: Brandon Guffey was born in York, South Carolina, lives in Rock Hill, and graduated from Northwestern High School in 1998.
His career experience includes owning and working as president of 360 HVAC.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, he said he served on the York County Council, District 6, from 2021 to 2022.
Guffey assumed office in the House on November 14, 2022, succeeding Bruce M. Bryant.
For 2025-2026 he was assigned to the Labor, Commerce and Industry Committee, after serving on the House Judiciary Committee and the Regulations and Administrative Procedures Committee in 2023-2024.
In the 2022 survey he listed judicial reform among his key campaign messages and described himself as an advocate for mental health reform and term limits.
The Republican primary for the 2026 election was canceled.
